$comment: The opening guide. Text lives here; the rule that completes each step lives in web/src/core/tutorial.ts, keyed by id. The build fails if the two ever disagree.

steps.title: Find your feet
steps.hint: Press and drag anywhere on the left of the screen to walk.

steps.title: Take what you find
steps.hint: Stand next to something glowing, then press the green button on the right.

steps.title: Fill the second orb
steps.hint: You carry two orbs and each holds one material. Gather another.

steps.title: Make something new
steps.hint: Press TRANSMUTE between the orbs to fuse what they hold.

steps.title: Something else lives here
steps.hint: Near an enemy the button turns red. Attacking always beats gathering, so you never pick a flower mid-fight.

steps.title: The bench
steps.hint: Open Bench to swap what the orbs hold, unload one, or break a material down into elements.
